name: Daily Brief
description: End-of-day executive brief synthesizing every meeting on one calendar day.

sections.title: Executive Overview
sections.instruction: A 2-4 sentence high-level narrative of the day's meetings, key outcomes, and overall trajectory

sections.title: Major Decisions
sections.instruction: Every decision made across the day's meetings, each attributed to its source meeting title in brackets

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: All action items with owner and the source meeting title when identifiable

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: Unresolved questions or items awaiting a decision, each attributed to its source meeting title

sections.title: Risks & Blockers
sections.instruction: Risks, blockers, and impediments raised during the day, with owners and source meeting titles

sections.title: Cross-Meeting Themes
sections.instruction: Topics, decisions, or concerns that appeared in more than one meeting during the day

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: Important follow-up meetings, commitments, or next steps for the coming days

sections.title: Meeting Digest
sections.instruction: One short paragraph per source meeting summarizing its purpose and outcome, preserving each meeting's title
